title: Identification of a Thyroid Hormone Binding Site in Hsp90 with Implications for Its Interaction with Thyroid Hormone Receptor Beta.
authors: Fan, Lu; Kishore, Anusha; Jansen-Olliges, Linda; Wang, Dahua; Stahl, Frank; Psathaki, Olympia Ekaterini; Harre, Jennifer; Warnecke, Athanasia; Weder, Julia; Preller, Matthias; Zeilinger, Carsten
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和实验研究T3与Hsp90结合及其对TRb互作的影响，涉及蛋白-DNA互作（TRb为转录因子）但未聚焦TF-DNA结合位点或三维互作建模，方法以实验为主、分子对接为辅，与课题部分相关。
abstract: While many proteins are known clients of heat shock protein 90 (Hsp90), it is unclear whether the transcription factor, thyroid hormone receptor beta (TRb), interacts with Hsp90 to control hormonal perception and signaling. Higher Hsp90 expression in mouse fibroblasts was elicited by the addition of triiodothyronine (T3). T3 bound to Hsp90 and enhanced adenosine triphosphate (ATP) binding of Hsp90 due to a specific binding site for T3, as identified by molecular docking experiments. The binding of TRb to Hsp90 was prevented by T3 or by the thyroid mimetic sobetirome. Purified recombinant TRb trapped Hsp90 from cell lysate or purified Hsp90 in pull-down experiments. The affinity of Hsp90 for TRb was 124 nM. Furthermore, T3 induced the release of bound TRb from Hsp90, which was shown by streptavidin-conjugated quantum dot (SAv-QD) masking assay. The data indicate that the T3 interaction with TRb and Hsp90 may be an amplifier of the cellular stress response by blocking Hsp90 activity.
abstract_zh: 尽管许多蛋白质已知是热休克蛋白90（Hsp90）的客户蛋白，但转录因子甲状腺激素受体β（TRb）是否与Hsp90相互作用以控制激素感知和信号传导仍不清楚。在小鼠成纤维细胞中，添加三碘甲状腺原氨酸（T3）可诱导更高的Hsp90表达。T3与Hsp90结合，并通过分子对接实验鉴定的T3特异性结合位点增强了Hsp90的三磷酸腺苷（ATP）结合能力。T3或甲状腺模拟物sobetirome可阻止TRb与Hsp90的结合。在pull-down实验中，纯化的重组TRb从细胞裂解液或纯化的Hsp90中捕获了Hsp90。Hsp90对TRb的亲和力为124 nM。此外，T3诱导了Hsp90上结合的TRb释放，这通过链霉亲和素偶联量子点（SAv-QD）掩蔽实验得到证实。数据表明，T3与TRb和Hsp90的相互作用可能通过阻断Hsp90活性来放大细胞应激反应。
